overlay.assistantText: Successfully delivered the Moment Diary frontend Web application.Key Deliverables: public/index.html: A clean, single-page application structure featuring:  Auth section (Login/Register)  Main Dashboard with Diary creation form  Diary List view  Timeline view with filtering capabilities public/styles.css: Modern, responsive styling with a professional color palette and intuitive UI components (cards, forms, timeline). public/app.js: Core frontend logic using native ES Modules, including:  Authentication handling with localStorage (token persistence).  Full CRUD operations for diaries via the backend API.  Timeline view with real-time filtering by mood and tags.  Unified error handling and automatic redirection to login on 401. src/app.ts: Updated with Hono's serveStatic middleware to serve the public/ directory, ensuring the app is accessible at http://localhost:3000.Acceptance Verification:  File Sizes: All frontend assets are verified to be over 1KB (index.html: ~4KB, app.js: ~8.5KB, styles.css: ~4.5KB).  API Standards: All requests include the Authorization: Bearer <token> header and use the application/json content type.  Static Serving: Hono serveStatic is correctly integrated at the end of the middleware chain.The application is now ready for use and fully integrated with the existing backend.
overlay.liveText: ✅ 评估：通过分类：evaluation项目完整交付了 Moment Diary 的前端 Web 应用，并正确对接了后端 API。通过对 public/index.html, public/app.js, public/styles.css 以及 src/app.ts 的审查，确认所有功能点（认证、日记 CRUD、时间轴视图、静态服务集成）均已按要求实现。代码结构清晰，符合原生 JS 开发规范，且逻辑严密（例如处理了 401 自动跳转和删除确认）。检查项✓ spec_check: The delivery successfully implements all requirements for the Moment Diary frontend.File Integrity: public/index.html (~4KB), public/app.js (~8.5KB), and public/styles.css (~4.5KB) all exceed the 1KB size requirement.Backend Integration: src/app.ts correctly includes the serveStatic middleware after all API routes, allowing the app to be served from the root.Authentication: The app handles registration and login via the specified API endpoints, stores the token in localStorage as moment_token, and manages the UI state (login vs. dashboard) based on authentication status.Diary Management: Full CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) are implemented. The code correctly handles the Authorization header and performs confirm() dialogs for deletions. The editDiary and deleteDiary functions are explicitly attached to the window object to ensure they are accessible from the inline event handlers in the generated HTML cards.Timeline View: The timeline view fetches data from /timeline and supports filtering by mood and tag, with automatic reloads when filters change.Error Handling: The application redirects to the login view on 401 errors and uses alert() for other errors as requested.While previous evaluations mentioned truncation, the provided file contents for public/app.js show a complete and valid JavaScript file ending with proper event listener initializations. All criteria are met.— evaluation_config: The Moment Diary frontend Web application is fully implemented and correctly integrated with the existing Hono-based backend.Features Delivered: Authentication: Complete flow for user registration and login. Tokens are securely managed in localStorage as moment_token. The UI automatically toggles between login/register forms and the main dashboard based on authentication state. Diary Management:  List View: Automatically loads and displays all user diaries with titles, mood emojis, content, tags, and formatted timestamps.  Create/Edit: A unified, responsive form allows users to create new entries or update existing ones (titles, content, mood selection, and comma-separated tags).  Delete: Includes a confirmation dialog before permanent deletion. Timeline View: A specialized view that fetches data from the /timeline endpoint. It supports dynamic filtering by mood and tags, updating the view automatically as filters change. Backend Integration: The src/app.ts file was updated to serve the public/ directory using Hono's serveStatic middleware, allowing the entire application to be hosted from http://localhost:3000.Technical Details:  Zero Dependencies: Built using pure HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript (ES Modules).  Standards Compliant: Implements the required Authorization: Bearer <token> headers and handles 401 Unauthorized responses by redirecting users to the login screen.  File Integrity: Verified that public/index.html, public/app.js (282 lines), and public/styles.css are all complete and exceed the 1KB size requirement.The application is now fully functional and meets all acceptance criteria.目标评估✅ 目标 1: Verified file existence and size via list_directory and read_file: public/index.html (89 lines), public/app.js (283 lines), and public/styles.css (265 lines) all exist and exceed 1KB. Backend integration verified in src/app.ts line 80: app.use('/*', serveStatic({ root: './public' })). Auth flow verified in public/app.js lines 94-133. CRUD operations verified in public/app.js lines 171-244. Timeline view verified in public/app.js lines 181-195.重规划建议根因：N/A - The task was successful.策略：The implementation is solid. For future iterations, consider implementing a more robust state management system if the app grows, and adding error boundaries for better resilience against API failures beyond simple alerts.
